harper: Quick heads-up  vendor pushing NVLink microcode swap on rack R9 in ap-south1. Window: Sat 2026-07-10 00:30-02:30 UTC. This is a sequenced microcode flip to resolve intermittent peer resets under sustained multi-gpu jobs. Expect brief host reboots and KV-cache misses. Aim: avoid full pool failover; prefer live-migrate then short reboot.

zane: Which pool and hosts? Any Dedicated tenants pinned?
 harper: Pool: ap-south1-gpu-pool-r9 (hosts r9-101..r9-108). Dedicated pinned: tenant-vision-9 on r9-104. Plan: attempt LM -> if fail, graceful drain and move workloads to warm spares in ap-south1-standby.

clare: Runbook sketch: mark hosts maintenance, pre-warm 3 spares in same AZ, bump autoscale cushion to 25% for 3h, do per-host microcode flip with 7m gap. Snippet: ```for h in r9-101..r9-108; do rctl maintenance add $h && infractl drain $h --grace 90 && vendorctl nvlink-flip $h && sleep 420; done```

mona: Running LM quick probe: `./bin/lm-check --pool ap-south1-gpu-pool-r9 --hosts r9-101..r9-108 --quick` will post shortly. Also flagging tenant-vision-9 as SLA-sensitive.

cost-bot: Note: cross-AZ failover would cost ~+22% for the window. Reserve burst budget required.

ryan: LM probe summary: 7/8 hosts passed. r9-104 (tenant-vision-9) failed LM due to driver mismatch. Recommend excluding r9-104 from LM automation and plan a manual patch window after vendor ops. Full logs attached to INFRA-1402.

harper: OK exclude r9-104 from automation. Action items: zane publish host->tenant map + opt-outs, clare spin up spares and set autoscale cushion, mona attach probe logs to INFRA-1402, ryan schedule manual patch post-maint, SRE-oncall stand by.

sre-oncall: I'll watch per-route 95p and 5xx. Abort thresholds: 5xx >2x baseline for 6m or 95p latency jump >150ms for 5m -> trigger failover.

zane: Uploaded mapping. Opt-outs: tenant-compliance-1 and tenant-payments flagged to be excluded from automation.

clare: I'll pre-warm 3 spares in ap-south1-standby and set `autoscalectl set-cushion --pool ap-south1-gpu-pool-r9 --cushion 25% --until 2026-07-10T05:00:00Z`. Also seeding top prefixes to reduce KV cold-start impact.

mona: Logs attached to INFRA-1402; r9-104 shows `nvml: driver api mismatch` during LM. Plan manual driver handshake and reboot after vendor flip.

harper: Final checklist: publish customer note 24h prior, exclude opt-outs and r9-104 from automation, pre-warm spares, bump cushion, SRE oncall ready. No objections?

zane: No objections. I'll draft customer comms and coordinate with tenant-relations for Dedicated.

harper: Thanks team  I'll pin runbook to INFRA-1402 and set the ops calendar. :white_check_mark:
